meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: Standard presentation of BoP as per BPM6, rupees (DBIE report 1502)
meta.coverage: Balance of payments in rupees, BPM6 standard presentation, every line
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1502 (Handbook copy), ₹ crore. The Bulletin copy (report 59) carries one later revision (January to March 2026) but labels both of that quarter's values 'provisional'; this copy labels its versions, so it is the one baked.
